Description.SourceString:
Perhaps it’s a little strange to wear the skin of your enemy, but who am I to judge? The Kalphite are certainly an imposing bunch and donning armour comprising of the most resilient parts of them certainly hits that survival game vibe, even if it is a little grim.

Fortunately, donning this leg armour does not change your legs into multiple skittering appendages. Aside from being deeply sinister, the animation team would murder me.

Kalphites are well adapted to the sands, they spread their weight out across all six legs, allowing them to move across the sands with relative ease. They can move fast too, something Moon Garou hunters discover all too late.
